# Where did your Shopify payout go, and which products actually make money?

> Free Shopify payout analyzer: drop in your Shopify Payments Transactions CSV and Orders export and get a fee waterfall, net to bank per order, profit per product, discount code cost and chargeback findings. Runs in your browser, the files are never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
